definitions.explanation: The joint connecting the upper arm and the forearm. The anatomical term for the elbow as a joint, used in medicine, sports, and physical therapy.

examples.japanese: {肘関節|ひじかんせつ}を{曲|ま}げる。
{転|ころ}んで{肘関節|ひじかんせつ}を{痛|いた}めた。
examples.english: I fell and hurt my elbow joint.

examples.japanese: {投球|とうきゅう}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}すと{肘関節|ひじかんせつ}に{負担|ふたん}がかかる。
examples.english: Repeated pitching puts a strain on the elbow joint.

notes:
Compound of {肘|ひじ} (elbow) + {関節|かんせつ} (joint). The technical term for the elbow joint, common in medical and sports contexts; in everyday speech people simply say {肘|ひじ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肘関節|ひじかんせつ}の{可動域|かどういき}: range of motion of the elbow joint
- {肘関節|ひじかんせつ}を{痛|いた}める: to injure the elbow joint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肘|ひじ}: elbow — the everyday word for the body part
- {関節|かんせつ}: joint — the general term for any joint in the body
